proposed_claim: Quantify classification dependence on tumour versus surrounding context
related_work_that_may_already_address_it: Existing lesion masking, occlusion, saliency, and shortcut-learning studies may address related questions; literature review not yet performed
evidence_needed: Systematic literature search and synthesis before making any novelty claim
planned_experiment: Compare original MRI, tumour-only, tumour-removed, and matched placebo-region inputs with patient-grouped evaluation
known_limitations: Masking artifacts, intensity distribution shift, clinically meaningful peritumoural anatomy, and imperfect masks may confound results

proposed_claim: Measure contextual reliance under controlled perturbations
related_work_that_may_already_address_it: Prior context ablation and image perturbation literature may overlap; scope remains to be verified
evidence_needed: Pre-registered interventions, matched controls, robustness checks, and leakage-safe model evaluation
planned_experiment: Use controlled context/background changes with unchanged label and matched placebo perturbations
known_limitations: Perturbations can introduce out-of-distribution artifacts and do not alone establish causality
status: planned; blocked until baseline gate passes

proposed_claim: Evaluate whether a mitigation reduces unwanted context reliance without harming tumour evidence use
related_work_that_may_already_address_it: Mask-guided training and augmentation methods may already exist
evidence_needed: Comparative experiments against a fixed baseline, external or held-out patient evaluation, and uncertainty estimates
planned_experiment: Compare mask-guided training or background randomization against the baseline
known_limitations: Potentially relies on annotation quality and may suppress clinically useful anatomy

proposed_claim: Use rigorous patient-level evaluation for reliance studies
related_work_that_may_already_address_it: Patient-grouped evaluation is established practice rather than a novelty claim
evidence_needed: Verified patient identifiers, fold isolation, and manual resolution of cross-fold near-duplicate candidates
planned_experiment: Nested patient-grouped evaluation after data-integrity gate clears
known_limitations: Patient identifiers may not fully capture shared acquisitions or source-level duplication
status: in progress; cross-fold candidate review unresolved
